scope: Actual completed 3D runs: API/export sample identity, provenance hashes and finite fields. Not an external accuracy benchmark.

runs.field_sampling: Meep get_array linearly interpolates all three electric components from the Yee lattice onto common cell-center coordinates; exported fields are float32 samples of the final solver state.

Four neighbouring Yee samples averaged spatially to each cell centre; positive outermost x/y/z cell omitted to avoid extrapolation. Raw staggered fields and material grid are preserved in the export. No temporal interpolation.
